verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability that acts on many items at once. The server-side migration import sends receipts through the per-receipt `POST /receipts` endpoint, which a user would have to loop over. Scheduled data exports deliver data out and do not perform operations on items. The MCP server and AI Toolkit manage products and entitlements, but nothing indicates batch or bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
